notes: «قراءة» (read-out mode) and «(رضي الله عنه)» are glosses, left out

Amir al-Mu'minin speaks and acts in the narrated scene («بينا أمير المؤمنين ... جالس مع أصحابه»): not a link, but a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks and acts, flagged for rule 11
